summary:
Test-infrastructure simplification is complete: factories/fixtures now reuse customers, invoices, organizations, payment methods, and a frozen clock. Subscription tests pass (52, 3 skipped), reports (28), invoices (46), payments (63), and the full suite passes in about 15 seconds: 318 passed, 4 skipped.

An intermittent concurrent invoice-sync `409` was reproduced. Duplicate submissions left idempotency records stuck in `processing`. The repository update is now guarded by the stored invoice ID, allowing the completed original response to be returned safely. Integration tests pass (8), unit tests pass (14), a concurrent regression test was added, and a 200-request stress test produced 8 initial successes plus 192 replays with no 500s and one completed idempotency row.

Billing typing fixes and prior CSV/search work remain complete. The invoice-credit ordering bug and Quebec QST correction are still outstanding. Kafka repartitioning remains undone. Keep commits small, use staging Redis `cache-eu-3` only, and avoid changing Celery visibility timeout.
per_round:
Completed CLI billing-filter cleanup: updated the remaining test to use `args.currency`, removed a duplicate invoice-list `--currency/-c` option by switching to the shared `_add_billing_filters()` helper, and verified help, parser behavior, abbreviations, and lint/whitespace checks. Relevant tests pass, including 37 CLI/command tests and a new abbreviation regression test; Ruff and `git diff --check` are clean. Also removed a stale comment about command-specific date filters.

Work then shifted toward invoice sync reliability/tracing. Located `WebhookSender` in `ledgerly/webhooks.py` and its existing tests. Added a configurable `max_attempts` constructor argument (default 3) and began implementing bounded exponential backoff using `time.sleep`, with request logic wrapped in a retry loop catching `httpx.TransportError`. Existing tests still assume a single attempt, so retry-specific tests and final validation remain to be completed. The stated OpenTelemetry tracing goal for invoice sync has not yet been implemented.

Completed the billing-filter cleanup and webhook retry work. `WebhookSender` now validates `max_attempts`, retries transport errors and retryable server responses with bounded exponential backoff, and re-raises after exhaustion; non-retryable client errors remain immediate failures. Added retry tests, patched sleeps, and verified 8 webhook tests and the full suite (44 passed), with Ruff and `git diff --check` clean.

Search rebuild performance work is also underway. Added scan timing and replaced per-invoice embedding calls with bounded concurrent batching, reducing a 5,000-invoice local rebuild from 8.42s to 3.16s. Updated the rebuilder mock for batch payloads; its suite now passes 15 tests. Profiling identified embedding latency, so documents are now chunked at 100, reducing profiling time to 1.87s. Full search-index baseline still has two failures involving rebuilt documents missing recently updated invoice descriptions.

The requested Kafka repartition migration has not been performed. Also honor branch separation for multi-ticket changes and do not modify `ledgerly/customer_export/` without proposed diff approval in `#privacy-review` from `@mina`.

Search rebuild optimization is complete: scans are tenant-scoped, embeddings use shared bounded batching, documents are chunked, and vector writes use a bulk transaction. A missing unique `(tenant_id, document_id)` index was added in migration `0042`. Search/management tests pass, and the full suite reports 247 passed, 4 skipped. A 10,000-document benchmark achieved a 2.41s median versus 16.73s previously; 5,000 vectors match 5,000 invoices without duplicates. The management command also reuses its embedding client.

Fixed CSV report encoding by explicitly writing UTF-8 and added Unicode regression coverage; all 8 CSV tests pass.

Do not retry increasing Celery visibility timeout—it was ruled out. Kafka repartition migration remains undone. Keep multi-ticket changes branch-separated, and do not modify `ledgerly/customer_export/` without Mina’s proposed-diff approval in `#privacy-review`.

CSV export now explicitly writes UTF-8, with regression coverage for Unicode names and cities. Exporter tests pass (24), as do the full suite (186 passed, 3 skipped), Ruff, and whitespace checks. The patch remains limited to `csv_export.py` and its test.

Search rebuild optimizations are complete, including tenant scoping, bounded shared embedding batches, chunking, bulk vector writes, migration `0042`, and benchmark improvements. The earlier full suite passed with 247 tests.

Billing typing is in progress: invoice and ledger signatures are being annotated with `Decimal`, `TypedDict`, `Iterable`, `Account`, and datetime types. Invoice tests still pass (12), and compilation succeeds. `mypy ledgerly/billing/invoices.py` currently reports one error: `build_invoice_lines` returns `Any` where `list[LineItem]` is declared; fix this next.

Operational notes: Kafka `orders.v1` has six partitions and replication factor three; repartitioning remains undone. Staging Redis must use `cache-eu-3`; never write to `cache-eu-1`. Do not increase Celery visibility timeout. Keep multi-ticket changes separate and avoid `ledgerly/customer_export/` without Mina’s approval.

CSV export and search-rebuild work are complete and validated. Billing typing fixes are also complete: generator output now matches its list annotation, discounts convert through `Decimal`, ledger timestamps are timezone-aware, and `mypy ledgerly/billing` is clean. Billing tests pass (34), with the full suite at 96 passed. A separate invoice-credit bug remains: `test_apply_credit_after_refund` expects `87.50` but receives `90.00`, likely because credit is applied before refund deduction.
